$comment: Public candidate contract with disabled semantics. governance_effect=none; authorization_effect=none; activation_effect=none.
title: XINGSHU Context Bridge Candidate Registered Context Reference
description: Portable public-candidate contract for the minimum shape of a relationship registered only after an external complete authorization chain. Schema validity alone does not prove Candidate, Proposal, deterministic Validation, Human Authorization, or cross-object linkage. Binding fields are intended to be immutable after registration, but duplicate protection, no-overwrite atomicity, immutable linkage, and lifecycle transition checks are deferred to a future deterministic validator and runtime contract. This schema does not activate a runtime capability.

schema_version.description: Candidate contract identity only; not a release, adoption, or activation version.

source_locator.description: Opaque Source identity or root anchor only. It does not authorize the entire root, and retrieval authority must not be derived from it.

source_entry_points.description: Exact ordered authorized retrieval entries. Array order is significant and must be preserved; implementations must not sort, auto-deduplicate, silently truncate, or derive these entries from source_locator.

access_scope.description: Final owner-controlled access-scope state established outside this schema.

allowed_clients.description: Final owner-controlled client authorization state. An empty array is explicitly valid and means deny all clients. Wildcard identifiers are forbidden.

retrieval_hint.description: Bounded operational hint; not Source content or an authority override.

status.description: Canonical Registered Context Reference lifecycle only. active may proceed to active-use checks but still requires current authorization, freshness, scope, and provenance; paused remains registered but cannot be used actively; source_unavailable means no current authoritative Source observation can be obtained; stale_locator means current locator or identity evidence no longer supports the registered relationship; revoked forbids use; archived is retained for history and does not authorize active use. Candidate and Proposal are separate object kinds, while stale data or a moved Source are observations rather than lifecycle states.

registration_authorization_id.description: Opaque pointer to external Human Authorization evidence. Its presence does not prove that the complete registration chain was validated.

last_verified_at.description: RFC 3339 verification timestamp when verified; null or absence is allowed only with null or absent verification_evidence_id.

verification_evidence_id.description: Opaque verification-evidence pointer when verified; null or absence is allowed only with null or absent last_verified_at.

content_fingerprint.description: Optional content fingerprint required when provenance_policy is locator_and_fingerprint. It contains no Source body.
